text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin JF, where 
powerhouse racers gather. Surrounded by 
Umamusume who were clearly on another 
level, Vodka found herself overwhelmed.

The Trainer encourages her, saying that 
even if she might lose, she should go out 
"looking cool" and give it everything 
she's got.

Relieved of her tension by those words, 
Vodka courageously headed out to challenge 
the race.
